company.description: Fashinza is a B2B marketplace that solves trend forecasting and sourcing for fashion brands and retailers. Fashinza's AI platform crunches data across multiple layers and platforms to predict the upcoming trends and designs. It combines the design platform with its cloud connected network of 200 factories to source products while providing a completely online experience.
